messages:
maya: dropping a tiny mock for the compact stream header. token chip + actions in one row. unsure on label semantics and SR behavior. image attached.

design-bot: uploaded image compact-stream-chip-v2.png :frame_with_picture:

sam: quick eng notes: debounce the token updates to ~1s and fix the chip width to avoid jitter. 'Stop' currently aborts; if we pick 'Pause' we need resumable state.
emily: copy recs: prefer 'Interrupt' (explicit). tooltip: 'Interrupt generation 12 preserves last partial output.' visible token microcopy: 'Tokens used: 1234'. tiny hint under chip: 'Shown for transparency'.

liam: a11y nits: stream should be aria-live="polite" and throttled. token chip aria-hidden=true + separate sr-only announcer updated less often (milestones/completion). ensure contrast 4.5:1.

maya: UX call: on regenerate keep last output + show subtle overlay spinner?
sam: yep keep it. simpler and less destructive.
emily: I'll add i18n keys and tooltips.

liam: I'll draft a short a11y QA checklist: focus order, live region throttle test, color contrast, keyboard stop behavior.

maya: decision for implementation: label = 'Interrupt'; token visible (debounced) + sr-only live updates on completion/milestone; preserve output on regen. i'll update mock and post v2. :thumbsup:
